# Facebook.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/facebook-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/facebook-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects data from Facebook.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Facebook in 2026](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-facebook)
- **Code:** [`facebook.py`](facebook.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Events](results/events.json) · [Group posts](results/group_posts.json) · [Marketplace](results/marketplace.json) · [Pages](results/pages.json)

## What it scrapes

- Facebook Marketplace listings with product details, prices, seller info, and locations
- Facebook Events with event details, dates, locations, and hosts

## Functions

- `scrape_facebook_events(event_name='New York, NY')` → `List[Dict]`
- `scrape_marketplace_listings(query='electronics')` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape Facebook Marketplace listings for a specific query
- `scrape_facebook_page(page_urls)` → `list[Dict]`: Scrape a Facebook page and return a FacebookPage
- `scrape_group_posts(group_urls)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape posts from one or more public Facebook groups

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import facebook


async def main():
    facebook_page = await facebook.scrape_facebook_page(
        page_urls=["https://www.facebook.com/bbcnews", "https://www.facebook.com/adidas/"],
    )
    marketplace_listings = await facebook.scrape_marketplace_listings(query="electronics")
    facebook_events = await facebook.scrape_facebook_events(event_name="New York, NY")
    group_posts = await facebook.scrape_group_posts(
        group_urls=[
            "https://www.facebook.com/groups/instantpotcommunity",
            "https://www.facebook.com/groups/dotnetdevelopers",
        ],
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/events.json`](results/events.json): `id`, `title`, `date`, `location`, `url`, `start_timestamp`, `is_online`, `event_kind`, `is_past`, `is_happening_now`, `is_hosted_by_ticket_master`, `location_details`, `cover_photo`, `social_context`
- [`results/group_posts.json`](results/group_posts.json): `post_url`, `group`, `group_url`, `posted_at`, `text`, `author`, `reactions`, `comments`, `shares`, `link_title`, `link_url`, `media`, `mentions`, `top_comments`
- [`results/marketplace.json`](results/marketplace.json): `id`, `title`, `price`, `location`, `is_sold`, `is_pending`, `creation_time`, `image_url`, `delivery_types`, `category_id`
- [`results/pages.json`](results/pages.json): `name`, `username`, `url`, `page_id`, `category`, `intro`, `likes`, `talking_about`, `were_here`, `phone`, `email`, `website`, `address`, `address_map_url`, `price_range`, `recommend_percent`, `review_count`, `confirmed_owner`, `profile_picture_url`, `cover_photo_url`, `social_links`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`facebook.py`](facebook.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser
- `js_scenario` = `JS`
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Notes

Note: This scraper is only scraping public Facebook data that doesn't require a login to access.

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/facebook-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_page_scraping`, `test_marketplace_scraping`, `test_events_scraping`, `test_group_posts_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
